edges.reason: approve authorizes msg.sender against the cached owner and isApprovedForAll, and reverts otherwise.
transferFrom passes msg.sender into _isApprovedOrOwner to gate the transfer.
setApprovalForAll forwards msg.sender as the approving owner.
publicMint uses msg.sender as the mint recipient.
onlySender requires msg.sender == tx.origin, creating tx.origin-dependent authorization on publicMint.
publicMinting requires block.timestamp >= publicMintStartTime, making mint availability miner-influenceable.
transferOwnership is protected by onlyOwner comparing owner to msg.sender.
setMintPrice is protected by onlyOwner comparing owner to msg.sender.
safeTransferFrom(data) performs an external staticcall to the recipient contract after state updates, exposing a recipient-controlled callback path.
The 3-argument safeTransferFrom delegates to the data variant.
safeTransferFrom(data) first calls transferFrom to move the token.
transferFrom calls _isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId_) for authorization.
transferFrom delegates the actual ownership write to _transfer.
multiTransferFrom loops over tokenIds_ calling transferFrom for each id.
multiSafeTransferFrom loops over tokenIds_ calling safeTransferFrom(data).
publicMint calls _mintMany(msg.sender, amount_) after payment and cap checks.
ownerMint calls _mintMany(to_, amount_).
ownerMintToMany loops calling _mintMany for each recipient/amount pair.
_mintMany loops calling _mint(to_, _startId + i).
_mintMany performs unchecked-by-intent supply arithmetic (totalSupply + amount_, _startId + i) that bounds the mint loop.
_transfer decrements and increments balances via unchecked-by-intent arithmetic on uint256.
_mint increments totalSupply, which in turn drives id allocation in _mintMany.
_mint writes ownerOf[tokenId_] = to_ without any authorization check.
_mint increments balanceOf[to_].
_transfer rewrites ownerOf[tokenId_] = to_.
_transfer mutates balanceOf[from_] and balanceOf[to_].
_transfer clears a stale getApproved entry via _approve when one exists.
_transfer conditionally calls _approve(address(0), tokenId_).
approve calls _approve(to_, tokenId_) after authorization.
setApprovalForAll calls _setApprovalForAll with msg.sender as owner.
_isApprovedOrOwner reads getApproved[tokenId_] when evaluating the spender.
_isApprovedOrOwner reads isApprovedForAll[_owner][spender_] when evaluating the spender.
tokenURI calls _toString(tokenId_) to build the metadata URI.
tokenURI reads baseTokenURI when composing the result string.
tokenURI reads baseTokenURI_EXT when composing the result string.
transferOwnership calls _transferOwnership(newOwner_).
renounceOwnership calls _transferOwnership(address(0)).
_transferOwnership writes the Ownable.owner state variable.
setBaseTokenURI forwards to _setBaseTokenURI.
setBaseTokenURI_EXT forwards to _setBaseTokenURI_EXT.
_setBaseTokenURI writes baseTokenURI.
_setBaseTokenURI_EXT writes baseTokenURI_EXT.
setMaxTokens writes the maxTokens cap, checked against totalSupply.
setPublicMintParams writes publicMintEnabled.
setPublicMintParams writes publicMintStartTime, the timestamp gate for minting.
setMintPrice writes mintPrice used in the publicMint payment check.
setMaxMintsPerTx writes the per-transaction mint limit.
publicMint checks msg.value == amount_ * mintPrice and maxMintsPerTx >= amount_, and loops amount_ mints.
_mintMany uses amount_ both in the supply bound check and as the loop counter bound.
multiTransferFrom iterates tokenIds_ and forwards each element to transferFrom.
_mint uses to_ as the ownership recipient.
_mint uses tokenId_ as the ownership key and duplicate check.
_transfer uses from_ in the owner equality require and balance decrement.
_transfer uses to_ as the new owner and balance increment target.
_transfer uses tokenId_ to read and rewrite ownership.
ownerMint forwards to_ to _mintMany.
ownerMint forwards amount_ to _mintMany.
_mintMany forwards to_ into each _mint call.
approve caches ownerOf[tokenId_] into _owner and compares it against msg.sender.
_mintMany derives _startId = totalSupply + 1 and adds i to it for each mint.
walletOfOwner copies totalSupply into _loopThrough and increments it inside the loop.
